## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug or type inference fix
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated test suites
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation improvement
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance or tooling update

## Checklist

- [ ] Code passes `npm run check` (Biome)
- [ ] TypeScript passes `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Vitest passes `npm test`
- [ ] Bundles build cleanly via `npm run build`
